description: Laid the short loaf, and had not brought a second bough.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, kept the firing off the slate, and took the threepence in the eating.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Went to his own work under his own name.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Ate, and did not tell her about Sunday.
name: William Shakespeare
